notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Nomad Mythmaker.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nomad Mythmaker, adding {W}.
Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Nomad Mythmaker to the battlefield.
Activate Nomad Mythmaker by paying {W} and tapping it, returning Gift of Immortality onto the battlefield attached to Nomad Mythmaker.
Repeat.
